body.p: I. Summary of Office Action and Reply
In the Office Action, the Office:
" Made the action non-final;
" Accepted the drawings;
" Acknowledged the claim for priority and receipt of the certified copies of
the priority documents;
" Examined the Application under the first inventor to file provisions of the
AIA;
" Withdrew Claims 7, 9, and 10 from further consideration
" Rejected Claims 14 and 15 under 35 U.S.C.112(b) as indefinite for failing
to particularly point out and distinctly claim the subject matter which the
inventor or a joint inventor regards as the invention;
" Rejected Claims 1-6, 8, 14, and 15 under 35 U.S.C. 102(a)(1) as anticipated
by Johnson (US 3,874,617 A);
" Objected to Claim 11 as dependent upon a rejected base claim, but would
be allowable if rewritten in independent form including all of the
limitations of the base claim and any intervening claims; and

By this Reply:

" Claim 14 is cancelled to address the rejection under 35 U.S.C. 112(b); " Claim 15 is amended to address the rejection under 35 U.S.C. 112(b); " Claim 1 is amended to incorporate the limitations of Claims 4 and 11;
" Claim 4 is cancelled without prejudice to reintroduce;
" Claim 5 is amended for consistency with the cancellation of Claim 4;
" Claim 11 is amended to incorporate the limitations of Claims 1-6 and 8 and
to place Claims 11-13 in condition for allowance;
" No new matter is added; and
" Claims 1-3, 5-8, 11-13, and 15 are at issue.
Applicant submits the Application is now in condition for allowance and requests same.
II. Discussion
The Office rejected Claim 1 as anticipated by Johnson.
In response, Claim 1 is amended. As amended, Claim 1 requires, among other things:

p.u: wherein the panel axis is located at a trailing ed
e end of the speed brake panel.

body.p: The amendment is supported in the original disclosure by, at least, Claims 4 and 11. Applicant submits that Claim 1, as amended, is allowable over Johnson for the following reasons.

Johnson does not anticipate amended Claim 1 because Johnson does not disclose a speed brake panel rotatable about a panel axis that is located at a trailing edge end of the speed brake panel. It is well-settled that a reference must disclose all the limitations of a claim to establish a prima facie case of anticipation. Here, Johnson does not disclose the claimed structure where the panel axis is located at a trailing edge end of the speed brake panel. Instead, according to Johnson, a spoiler (S) pivots about pivot point (Y). Pivot point (Y) is located at a leading edge end of spoiler (S). Additionally, the Office identified the claimed structure as patentable subject matter: "the prior art does not teach the combined limitations of the claimed invention wherein the panel axis is located at the trailing edge end of the speed brake panel." Therefore, Claim 1, as amended, is structurally distinguished from Johnson's device.
III. Conclusion

In view of the foregoing amendments and remarks, Applicant respectfully submits that the Application is in condition for allowance. If deficiencies remain, Examiner may contact the undersigned to facilitate allowance of this case.
The Commissioner is hereby authorized to charge any additional fees which may be required to this application under 37 C.F.R. §§ 1.16-1.17, or credit any overpayment, to Deposit Account No. 07-2069.
Respectfully submitted,
